prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Click and drag to interact or right-click for quick actions.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or manage your pet."]
1: ["Define Your Pet's Personality", "Select how your companion behaves and reacts while living on your desktop.", "Save Personality", "Choose Temperament"]
2: []
3: ["Checking Pet Generation Assets", "Verifying image proportions and rendering settings for optimal desktop display.", "Confirm Pet Appearance", "Here is how your pet will render on your desktop background.", "Looks Great"]
4: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "Building 3D models, AI behavior engines, and desktop animations.", "Step 2 of 3: Calibrating desktop movement dynamics"]
5: ["Secure Your Companion Account", "Sign in to save your pet's memory, items, and personality traits permanently.", "Your pet customization and progress are linked safely to this account.", "Cloud Backup Secured"]
6: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Pick an instant ready-to-play companion or create your own custom pet from scratch.", "You can change or customize your pet anytime later!"]
7: ["Choose Your Adoption Journey", "Select the path that fits how quickly you want your pet on your screen.", "Select Adoption Method"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your adoption is official and includes 100 bonus care points.", "Certified Companion Owner"]
9: ["Preparing Desktop Arrival", "We'll alert you the instant your pet steps onto your desktop screen.", "Notify Me When Ready"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bonus gifts
